messages:
nicole_sales: Customer (GlobalCust) wants confirmation: can we do node-by-node rolling upgrades in a fully air-gapped on‑prem POC? They also want a 48h emergency patch SLA option and wording for the security questionnaire about image signing.

omar_se: TL;DR: yes, rolling upgrades supported if images are imported to a local registry and workloads have appropriate replicas. Operator will orchestrate per-pod updates but DB migrations may need maintenance windows.

lee_eng: detail: we ship signed minibundles (tar.gz) with manifests and detached sig (Notary v2 style). For airgap flow we provide an import tool (ctr/nerdctl) and a preflight that checks registry behavior (rewrites content IDs). Delta bundles shrink transfer size but need consistent layer IDs across nodes.

ops_kate: POC hotfixs: we can offer a POC add-on (48h triage + delta/minibundle build + remote assist). Pricing to quote. Note: if preflight finds registry rewriting, plan extra time for full bundle import (~1–2h).

nicole_sales: please give a one-paragraph SOW blurb I can paste.

omar_se: SOW blurb: "Redwood will provide signed offline bundles and an operator that supports node-by-node rolling updates for air-gapped clusters when images are pre-imported to a local registry. Customers should run a preflight to validate registry behavior; replica counts >=2 recommended for stateful services to preserve availability. Monthly security drops are available during the POC and an optional 48-hour emergency hotfix add-on can be purchased."

lee_eng: add verification snippet for the questionnaire:

```
sha256sum bundle-2026-03-05.tar.gz
cosign verify-blob --signature bundle-2026-03-05.tar.gz.sig bundle-2026-03-05.tar.gz
ctr images import bundle-2026-03-05.tar.gz
```

ops_kate: ops caveat to include in questionnaire: if you elect BYO registry that mutates content IDs, we will require a manifest-mapping step or fallback to full minibundles. Preflight typically <30min.

nicole_sales: great — I'll send email with SOW blurb, pricing note, verification snippet, and request for jumpbox/reg access and whether they want Redwood-signed POC bundles or BYO KMS. tagging @signing-bot for automated artifact info.

signing-bot: bundle 2026-03-05 created by @lee_eng (sha256:beefcafe...); detached signature uploaded."
